name: IconTile
purpose: Pair a single icon with a colored, sized background shape for use cases that need greater visual emphasis.
intent: Provide a non-interactive, scannable colored icon container distinct from Icon Button (interactive) and Badge/Tag (text content).

figmaIconProperty.name: icon
figmaIconProperty.note: Exposed as a component property, not a Figma slot (slots array was empty).

apiAdaptationNotes: Figma's flattened 20-value `appearance` property was split into two independent props - `tone` (hue/meaning) and `appearance` (default/bold weight) - to follow this system's existing convention of separating emphasis from meaning (see Button).
Figma's `circle` shape value was renamed to `round` to match Icon Button's existing `shape` prop naming (`square` | `round`).
Figma's `icon` INSTANCE_SWAP property is exposed as `children`, matching Icon Button's convention for a component whose sole content is an icon.

useCases: leading visual in a list item
antiPatterns: hover, focus, pressed, or disabled behavior

anatomy.description: Single centered icon; inherits the root's color and fills the computed icon-size box.

children.description: The icon element to render, centered inside the tile.

appearance.description: Visual weight - default is a subtle tint, bold is a solid saturated fill with an inverse icon.

shape.description: Container shape - rounded-square or fully round.

size.description: Overall tile size; icon size is derived as 2/3 of the tile size.

decorative.description: When true, the tile is aria-hidden. When false, renders role=img with ariaLabel.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible label used only when decorative is false.

default.purpose: Subtle tint background with a tinted icon.

bold.purpose: Solid saturated background with an inverse (white) icon.

slots.name: children
supports: a single icon from the generated icon set

requirements: Use decorative=false with ariaLabel only when no adjacent text already conveys the same meaning.
Ensure color contrast meets requirements for all tone/appearance combinations.

behaviorRules: Do not make Icon Tile focusable.
Do not add hover, pressed, active, loading, or disabled states.
Default tone is brand, default appearance is default, default shape is square, default size is md.
Apply data-tone, data-appearance, data-shape, and data-size equal to the selected values.
Force the passed-in icon to inherit color and fill the computed icon-size box by overriding its own data-color/data-size attributes.
compositionRules: Icon Tile may appear in feature sections, empty states, cards, and list items.
Use Icon Button instead if the icon needs to be clickable.
Use Badge or Tag instead of Icon Tile for text/count content.
Pass any icon from the generated icon set as children; it does not need its own color or size props set.
themeRules: Must work in light and dark themes.
All background/content colors use semantic CSS variables that already resolve per-theme.
implementationNotes: Use React.memo for the exported component.
No hardcoded colors, spacing, radius, or typography when tokens exist.
Icon size is derived via calc() as 2/3 of the container size rather than five separate icon-size tokens, since the Figma source data confirms an exact 2/3 ratio at every size.

The icon color/size override uses a compound CSS Modules + :global() attribute selector against the icon's own data-color/data-size attributes, mirroring Icon Button's existing `.content :global([data-color])` pattern - this reliably wins specificity over the icon's own single-class color/size rules without needing !important.
do: Use for feature call-outs and empty states.
Use bold appearance for stronger visual weight.
Use round shape to match nearby circular elements like Avatar.
Keep implementation simple - one icon, no text.
dont: Do not use for clickable actions.
Do not use for count/text content.
Do not pass more than one icon.
acceptanceCriteria: Defaults to tone=brand, appearance=default, shape=square, size=md.
Supports all IconTileTone, IconTileAppearance, IconTileShape, and IconTileSize values.
Applies data-tone, data-appearance, data-shape, and data-size for the selected values.
decorative=true (default) renders aria-hidden with no role.
decorative=false renders role=img with aria-label from ariaLabel.
Uses tokenized sizing, radius, and colors for every tone/appearance/shape/size combination.
Icon inherits tile color and fills the computed icon-size box regardless of the icon's own defaults.
Storybook includes Playground, Variants, Sizes, Shapes, and Composition.
Tests cover children, defaults, each prop, decorative behavior, className, and token usage.
knownLimitations: No xl size (Figma source has none).
Icon color/size override relies on the icon's data-color/data-size attributes existing, which is only guaranteed for icons built on the shared Icon primitive.
futureEnhancements: xl size if Figma adds one
